nodes.description: Mapping (uint => data) storing company and valid_date records; persistent contract storage.
Public function save(uint256 _id, string _company, string _valid_date) that writes records into the datas mapping without any access control.
Public view function readCompany(uint8 _id) returning datas[_id].company.
Public view function readValidDate(uint8 _id) returning datas[_id].valid_date.
State write datas[_id].company = _company executed by an unrestricted public function; any caller can overwrite stored records.
State write datas[_id].valid_date = _valid_date executed by an unrestricted public function; any caller can overwrite stored records.
uint256 _id parameter of save, used as the storage index for the datas mapping.
string _company parameter of save, written into datas[_id].company.
string _valid_date parameter of save, written into datas[_id].valid_date.
uint8 _id parameter of readCompany, used to index the datas mapping for reading.
uint8 _id parameter of readValidDate, used to index the datas mapping for reading.
